The '''Perlemia system''' was a [[Star system/Legends|star system]] in the [[Core Worlds/Legends|Core Worlds]] on the [[Perlemian Trade Route/Legends|Perlemian Trade Route]]. Owing to the output of the [[Shipyard/Legends|shipyards]] around its planet [[Perlemia]], the system was the namesake of the [[Hyperspace route/Legends|hyperlane]]. The shipyards were destroyed during the [[Tionese War]].<ref name="The Essential Guide to Warfare">''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''</ref>

==Behind the scenes==
[[Daniel Wallace]], author of ''[[The Essential Atlas]]'', indicated that the system is located at or near one end point of the Perlemian Trade Route, and was presumably the source of the trade route's name. This information was confirmed as canon with the publication of ''[[The Essential Guide to Warfare]]''.
